data.title: Editor icon themes claim only the dotted .kadence folder name
data.why: Kadence WP — the WordPress theme plus Kadence Blocks, 600k+ active installs — ships a theme folder named 'kadence'. An icon association on the bare name would mislabel their folders in every WordPress project, and in that ecosystem the name was theirs first. Our journal directory is always '.kadence', so the dotted form loses nothing. Material Icon Theme cannot be restricted this way: its generator expands one folder name into every prefix variant, so PR #3600 names the collision in the body and leaves the call to its maintainers, while vscode-icons PR #4267 lists '.kadence' alone.
data.rejected: Claim both 'kadence' and '.kadence' everywhere, as most icon entries do; Submit no icon PRs until kadence has adoption of its own
